title: Past Simple: irregular verbs & was/were
summary: Learn common irregular Past Simple forms and use was/were for the verb be.

explanation.en: Irregular verbs have special past forms such as went, saw and had. The past of be is was/were.
explanation.ru: Неправильные глаголы имеют особые формы Past Simple: went, saw, had и т. д. Прошедшие формы be — was/were.

forms.label: Irregular verbs
forms.pattern: go → went · see → saw · have → had · take → took

examples.en: They were tired after the trip.

commonMistakes.note: Use were with you, we and they.
